notes.title: Journey so far..
notes.content:
[h2]Artifice: War Tactics - Major Updates Overview[/h2] 
  
Hello, Strategists!
    
With the official release of [b]Artifice: War Tactics[/b] just around the corner, it's time to look back at the major updates we've rolled out during our Early Access period. Each update has been crucial in enhancing the gameplay experience, and we owe it all to your invaluable feedback and support.

        [h3]Major Update 1: New Character and Bug Fixes[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]New Champion:[/b] Added a new champion, each with unique abilities that enhance strategic depth.[/*]        [*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved several critical bugs, improving game stability and performance.[/*]        [*][b]UI Improvements:[/b] Enhanced interface for better navigation and user experience.[/*]    [/list]    
In our first significant update, we introduced a new champion to the roster, bringing fresh abilities and strategies to the battlefield. We focused on addressing key bugs and improving overall game stability, ensuring a smoother experience for our players.

    [h3]Major Update 2: Gameplay Changes and Balance Updates[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]Balance Adjustments:[/b] Reworked champion abilities and enemy AI for more dynamic battles.[/*]        [*][b]New Items:[/b] Introduced a variety of new items to expand tactical options.[/*]        [*][b]Improved Mechanics:[/b] Refined core mechanics to enhance tactical depth and player engagement.[/*]    [/list]    
The second update brought substantial gameplay changes and balance adjustments to enhance strategic depth. We refined champion abilities and reworked several game mechanics to provide a more challenging and rewarding tactical experience.

    [h3]Major Update 3: New Champion and Closed Beta[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]New Champion:[/b] Added a new champion with distinct skills, further diversifying team strategies.[/*]        [*][b]Closed Beta Launch:[/b] Initiated a closed beta for players to test upcoming features and provide feedback.[/*]        [*][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b] Made several interface and usability enhancements based on player feedback.[/*]    [/list]    
This update unveiled another new champion, adding more diversity to your tactical options. We also launched a closed beta phase, allowing select players to test upcoming features and provide feedback, helping us shape the future of the game.

    [h3]Major Update 4: Controller Support and New Biome[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]Full Controller Support:[/b] Implemented full controller support for an enhanced gaming experience.[/*]        [*][b]New Biome:[/b] Introduced a new biome with unique challenges and environments.[/*]        [*][b]Visual Upgrades:[/b] Improved graphics and animations for more immersive gameplay.[/*]    [/list]    
With the fourth major update, we introduced full controller support, making the game more accessible to a wider audience. We also added a new biome, complete with unique challenges and environments, expanding the game's world.

    [h3]Major Update 5: Ability Upgrades and New Champion[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]Ability Upgrades:[/b] Enabled players to upgrade champion abilities, adding depth to strategy.[/*]        [*][b]New Champion:[/b] Introduced a new champion with specialized tactics and abilities.[/*]        [*][b]New Quests and Items:[/b] Added additional quests and items to further enrich gameplay.[/*]    [/list]    
Our fifth update focused on enhancing the depth of gameplay with ability upgrades, allowing players to further customize and strengthen their champions. Additionally, we introduced a new champion, bringing fresh tactics and strategies to explore.

    [h3]Major Update 6: Launch with New Battles and Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]    
[b]Highlights:[/b]
    [list]        [*][b]New Battles and Bosses:[/b] Launched new challenging battles and formidable bosses to conquer.[/*]        [*][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b] Implemented player-suggested improvements for a refined experience.[/*]        [*][b]Expanded Champion Roster:[/b] Added new champions with unique abilities for diverse tactics.[/*]    [/list]    
The final update marks the official launch of [b]Artifice: War Tactics[/b], featuring new battles, bosses, and champions. We've implemented numerous gameplay enhancements based on player feedback, ensuring an unforgettable tactical experience.
    
We are thrilled to share this journey with all of you and can't wait for you to experience everything [b]Artifice: War Tactics[/b] has to offer. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in shaping the game, and we are incredibly grateful.
    
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Major Update 2 - Major Gameplay Changes, Balance Updates & more!
notes.content:
We are equally thrilled and nervous to announce this next big update for Artifice: War tactics. From all the feedback we have received we have concluded that the game as it stands is not fun enough and lacks emergent gameplay due to the probabilistic nature of its combat system. As such the game will now feature an active combat system that will allow players to attack during their turn rather than setting an overwatch. Such a massive change was a tough pill to swallow at first but after a lot of playtesting we feel confident that overall, this system feels way more intuitive, exciting, emergent, and frankly more fun. We hope you enjoy this update and as always please feel free to reach out to us with your feedback. Tons more updates coming soon so stay tuned.

notes.title: Launch Patch Log
notes.content:
[b]Artifice: War Tactics now includes the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 Islands: Aziera and Mycella.
[*] 5 Battle Modes: Vanquish, Ambush, Escort, Retrieve and Rescue.
[*] 6 Champions: Zephyr, Pyromancer, Ranger, Berserker, Pathfinder, and Blood Fury.
[*] 8 Enemy Types: Sellsword, Bowmen, Terrodon, Siege Breaker, Shaman, Death Cap, Shroom Knight, and Shroomancer.
[*] 2 Bosses: Xo’Azora and Queen Mycella.
[*] 61 Items: Attack, Defense, and Utility.
[*] 3 Biomes: Snow, Desert, and Boss Arena.
[*] Biome Hazards: Sandworm (Desert) and Snow (Frost Wraith).
[*] Champion Trait and Ability upgrades.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Concussive blast upgrade reworked with a new status effect “Winded” that disables the target’s overwatch for 1 turn.
[*] Frost Wraith now repositions at the start of player turn.
[*] Sandworm and Frost Wraith now attack after every overwatch trigger rather than at the end of all of them. 
[*] Double move (Ember Bomb) is now a self-casting ability.
[*] Updated Biome hazards spawn Logic. Hazards no longer spawn in the same grid twice.
[*] Reworked Multiple Champion Abilities: 
[*] Zephyr: Swapped Eagle Eye with Pathfinder’s Dual-Watch ability.
[*] Ranger: True Strike replaced with Armor Chink.
[*] Pyromancer: Cauterize replaced with Cleansing Flames and Fire Bomb replaced with Napalm.
[*] Berserker: Rampage replaced with Cleave.
[*] Pathfinder: Swapped Dual-Watch with Zephyr’s Eagle Eye ability.
[*] Blood Fury: Splinter Bomb replaced with Sacrificial Edict and Assassinate.
[*] Added turn timer trigger in Retrieve mode. Turn timer begins only after retrieving the artifact.
[*] Sandworm now inflicts bleed, but damage is reduced by 1.
[*] Reworked Frost Bite (now does Armor Negation).
[*] Updated the XP reward logic.
[*] Removed Burn, Poison, and Bleed resistance stats and replaced with a unified Resistance stat.
[*] Reworked stats for all enemies and champions.
[/list]

[b]Polish and Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a highlight on the hover for any interactive objects or NPCs – such as Artifact, Biome hazards, etc.
[*] Implemented partial controller support.
[*] Toggle has been replaced with press and hold to inspect characters during gameplay.
[*] Material pass for Theosus statue and other environmental props.
[*] Added Ember Bomb explosion particle effect.
[*] Added a highlight effect on hover for all characters.
[*] In-game character panel with detailed stats, equipped items, and previews of their traits and abilities.
[*] HP stat now shows both the current and maximum HP values.
[*] Improved AI responsiveness (reduced delays).
[*] Visual polish updates on the World Map.
[*] Province details now show up for all captured provinces.
[*] Captured provinces are indicated by a green outline on the World Map.
[*] New sprite animation in the Main Menu.
[*] Updated animations for all Zaha’Ryn enemies (Terrodon, Siege breaker, and Shaman).
[*] Updated trait, ability, and stat icons for multiple champions and enemies.
[*] Updated Frost Wraith’s idle animation.
[*] Minor HUD improvements.
[*] Removed injured state animations for all champions.
[*] Updated the trajectory of casting on a targetable ability.
[*] Added an animation for when a Jazis shard is consumed.
[*] Updated the Tutorial Flow.
[*] Added a turn timer below the turn start banner.
[*] Added Defeat text prompts for all battle modes.
[*] Improved Character Selection, Move, and Overwatch UX.
[*] Tooltips now appear on Threat and Opportunity tiles.
[*] Added a visual indicator (blue zone) in Retrieve Mode to interact with the Artifact. 
[*] Hovering over a threat tile (indicated by red exclamation mark) now shows trajectory lines to the corresponding enemies with overlapping overwatches.
[*] On hovering over a move tile, crossed-sword icons may appear over one or more enemies to indicate attack opportunities.
[*] Updated Portrait videos for all characters.
[*] Snow Level visual updates.
[*] Added a fog of war effect for new provinces on the World Map.
[*] Updated particle effects for Abilities and Traits.
[*] Added a desaturation effect to the HP bar for champions and enemies after moving and setting an overwatch.
[*] Added a “Level Up” text prompt in the victory screen for all Champions when gaining experience.
[*] Updated Input Icons.
[*] Added Buffs on Mini HUD.
[*] Updated the cursor with a crosshair when casting on a targetable ability.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Martyr’s Rite no longer heals the target.
[*] Removed the Secondary Objective from Boss Battles.
[*] Fixed Snow Level and Shade LOD issues.
[*] The execute modifier no longer triggers on Boss characters.
[*] Targets now react to Siege Breaker’s attacks.
[*] The Raider’s attacks are now triggering as intended.
[*] Player stats now update correctly when equipping items with a negative HP stat value.
[*] Provinces revealed post-victory are no longer assigned identical battle modes.
[*] Primary and secondary rewards no longer appear for provinces revealed post-victory.
[*] Miscellaneous minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: ⭐ The journey so far ⭐
notes.content:
It all started with a shared love for turn-based strategy games. A group of passionate gamers gathered in the vibrant city of Bangalore, India, with a singular mission: to create a game that would redefine the genre.

Our journey began in January 2020, just a few months before the world changed in ways we could never have imagined. As we started our journey, we found ourselves navigating not only the intricacies of developing a passion project but also the challenges of a global pandemic.

In those early days, the team consisted of Neeraj Kumar, Aubhik Nath, Ekta Neeraj Verma, and Vishal Mohan. Together, we set out to create something truly unique.

But it wasn't all smooth sailing. We faced our fair share of obstacles. Our studio specialized in design and technology, but we lacked in-house artists. Undeterred, we rolled up our sleeves, conducted extensive research, and sought help from our friends. The result? A game that exceeded our own expectations, filled with stunning visuals.

What makes Artifice: War Tactics special, you ask? It's all about reactive combat. We wanted to give players a fresh perspective on turn-based strategy, where every move counts and every decision has consequences.

Our inspirations were clear - XCOM, Into the Breach, and Darkest Dungeon. These legendary titles guided us on our journey and helped shape Artifice into what it is today.

But game development isn't just about code and pixels; it's also about the moments that make you laugh, the challenges that make you grow, and the friendships that make it all worthwhile.

Through this rollercoaster ride, we learned valuable lessons. We understood the importance of leveraging our team's strengths, beginning marketing early, and setting achievable milestones.

Today, as we stand on the cusp of a new adventure, we want you to know that Silvine Game Studios is more than just a game development studio. We're a group of dreamers, creators, and gamers, fueled by our passion for crafting unforgettable experiences.

Our ultimate goal? To bring the best gaming experience to you, the players, and to inspire you to pursue your own passions. Artifice: War Tactics is just the beginning of our story.

So, what's next, you ask? We're gearing up to launch Artifice on Early Access in the coming months. Brace yourselves for a journey filled with updates, new features, and epic battles. But that's not all. Beyond Early Access, we have plans to bring Artifice to consoles and are already brainstorming ideas for our next exciting project.

notes.title: Devlog #2: Introducing Artifice: War Tactics
notes.content:
Hello gamers! After making a few posts we realized that we've never really talked about how our game came into existence so in today's post we are going to try to break it down in a few paragraphs. Let's start from the beginning.

When Silvine Game Studios first came to life, we were a group of passionate game developers with a shared love for the turn-based strategy genre. Games like XCOM, Into the Breach, and Darkest Dungeon fueled our conversations, and we realized we wanted to create something special in this space.

Our discussions during coffee breaks were filled with endless tactical strategies, squad compositions, character upgrades, and exhilarating enemy encounters. The idea of sharing our experiences and creating a game that would ignite the same passion in others soon became our mission.

The initial spark for Artifice: War Tactics came from the Overwatch ability (from XCOM), where players could set up a Killzone to ambush enemies. We pondered what would happen if we took this concept further, creating a more reactive gameplay experience. Thus, the idea of establishing automatic attack zones was born.

Imagine a scenario where all characters in the game would set up attack zones during their turn. These zones would trigger automatically when enemies stepped into them during their turn, adding a unique and strategic twist to the gameplay. This concept quickly captured our imagination and became the foundation of Artifice: War Tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134043/f730469c91630020aa4a9da6946686af9cd6ab28.gif[/img]

To make this idea work, we realized that all characters needed restrained movement and attack patterns, similar to the strategic nature of chess. This revelation led us to establish the first three core pillars of the game: Deduce, Anticipate, and Maximize.

🔹 Deduce: Observing enemy positions and deducing where they are most likely to set up an ambush. Analyze the battlefield, study enemy behavior, and plan your moves accordingly.

🔹 Anticipate: Predicting enemy movement patterns to position your champions strategically for maximum impact. Stay one step ahead by understanding your opponents and their likely next moves.

🔹 Maximize: Set up attack zones to trigger a chain reaction of devastating combos. Plan your actions carefully to hit as many enemies as possible, optimizing your chances of victory.

As we iterated and refined this concept, we started with pen and paper prototypes, working diligently to create an engaging and immersive experience. The gameplay mechanics evolved, the art style took shape, and the world of Artifice began to come alive.

It feels unreal when we see how far we've come. And we're grateful to share this progress with all of you. We invite you all to join us on this thrilling journey. We are a small indie dev studio, but our game promises a fresh and dynamic take on turn-based strategy games. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting announcements. We are looking forward to sharing it all with you 🥰.

notes.title: Devlog #1: Boss Concept Art Reveal
notes.content:
After pouring our hearts into this, We are thrilled to unveil the next character from Artifice: War Tactics. Behold the enigmatic Xo'Azora, a once benevolent ruler who now finds himself entangled in a web of paranoia and xenophobia under the influence of Theosus the Immortal. His sole mission? To eradicate the Onkas, Nubarians, and the Drongites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134043/c28c58f7633a4b2d286fcc60faaa6859bdf08fe8.png[/img]

At Silvine Game Studios, we follow a meticulous approach to character creation. We start with a bottom-up methodology, focusing on fleshing out the character's traits and mechanics within the game. We delve into conceptualizing the backstory, motivation, and persona that drives our character, while also considering their species—be it anthropomorphic, human, demon, or beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134043/b9a444fd507535cea223414f403ded09bf0d62b4.png[/img]

Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of ancient Egypt and Persia, Xo'Azora's design exudes power and authority, while capturing the essence of his ancient lineage.Through a series of internal discussions and iterations, we refine the character's concept until a final draft is ready. Our talented artists then take the reins, translating the vision into stunning line drawings for the concept art. Once the line drawing receives the green light, we proceed to infuse the character with vibrant colors and captivating visual effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134043/ac3f16ad6e3546e72b6ecbe44dce4e9548496071.png[/img]

But we don't stop there. Our production phase takes the character into the realm of 3D modeling, ensuring that every angle and detail is brought to life, aligned with our desired stylization and aesthetics. Rigging and animation follow suit, breathing movement and fluidity into Xo'Azora's actions. Ultimately, our character is integrated into the game, replacing any placeholders, and undergoing rigorous testing to ensure a seamless gameplay experience.

Finally, we reach the post-production stage, where we iron out bugs, address issues, and polish Xo'Azora until he shines brilliantly within our game's universe.

We are beyond excited to share this concept art with all of you, and we can't wait to witness the impact he will make in our game. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to bring this captivating world to life. Your support means the world to us!

notes.title: Thank you, Gamers!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

We want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for your incredible support during our participation in the Steam Next Fest June 2023.

Thank you for your overwhelming response and the tremendous support you have shown us throughout. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and engagement have been very helpful, and it has given us more perspective. Thank you for tuning into our live streams and boosting our morale. We are definitely looking forward to doing more Devs play live streams. We are truly humbled by the amazing response we have gotten from all of you.

Moving forward, we are committed to keep working on our game and officially release it in the coming months. We would definitely need your constructive feedback and support to make that happen. As some of you might already know, we have been developing Artifice: War Tactics for more than 3.5 years now, and as we are getting closer to the launch, it literally feels like our dream of making a kickass turn-based strategy game for the world is coming true. We couldn't be happier to share this with you.
